# WalkRoutes

Kind: component · Defined in [`src/logic/agents/walk_routes.h`](../../../src/logic/agents/walk_routes.h) · Scene / prefab name: `WalkRoutes` · Described in `data/agents_motion.json`

Slope band and spawn area of a walker's routes on uneven ground; on the entity with HumanBotSpawn.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `up` | `float` | steepest climb along a path (20 degrees) (default 0.349066) |
| `down` | `float` | steepest descent along it (7 degrees: beyond, the kinematic walk's swing knee passes 95 degrees) (default 0.122173) |
| `across` | `float` | steepest slope across it (12 degrees) (default 0.209440) |
| `length` | `float` | m of path ahead that must stay in the band (default 12.0) |
| `half_width` | `float` | m to each side of the path that must stay in it too (default 1.0) |
| `clear` | `float` | m around a spawn point where the ground is no steeper than the least of the three, whatever the direction (default 1.5) |
| `centre` | `glm::vec2` | spawn points are drawn within spawn_radius of it (x, z) (default glm::vec2(0.0)) |
| `spawn_radius` | `float` | m around centre where spawn points are drawn (default 1000.0) |
| `direction_tries` | `int` | directions tried from a point, spread evenly around it (default 96) |
| `spawn_tries` | `int` | points tried for a spawn (default 20000) |

## Notes

Angles are radians in the component, degrees in JSON (each between 0 and 80). Validation: length > 0, spawn_radius >= 0, direction_tries and spawn_tries >= 1. Read by drawStart / drawDirection (GaitRoutes, and the physical walker's Task on the terrain); GaitRoutes overrides length with the episode's path length on a copy.

## Systems that touch it

Read only by: AgentFactory, AnimalFactory, GaitRoutes. Written by: —. Created by: —. Destroyed by: —.

| System | Kind | Scope | Access | Where | What it does with it |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|

## Side effects of those systems

- **[AgentFactory](../systems/AgentFactory.md)**
  - Reads resources/<body> and resources/<params> and hashes them (SHA-256); throws AssetError on a malformed file.
  - Creates 16 Jolt bodies and, for a dynamic walker, 15 swing-twist constraints with motors; removes them at finish.
  - Moves the static Ground bodies at every episode start (slope) and sets the segments' poses, velocities and mass properties.
  - Creates the drawn shape entities when draw is set; they live as long as the world.
  - Logs errors without a HumanBotSpawn entity or with WalkRoutes but no ground field, a warning when no spawn point is found in the slope band.
- **[AnimalFactory](../systems/AnimalFactory.md)**
  - Reads the body file, the params file and the ranges file (params and ranges hashed with SHA-256); throws AssetError when one is missing.
  - Creates the ragdoll's Jolt bodies and constraints; destroys them in finish.
  - Creates one entity per segment shape when draw is set.
  - Logs an error without an AnimalSpawn, a warning when a routed reset finds no spawn point in the slope band.
- **[GaitRoutes](../systems/GaitRoutes.md)**
  - Destroys the old legs' IK chain and target entities at each new route (the arms' ones, if any, are left behind).
  - Logs a warning when no route in the slope band is found.
